shared_elements: low relief carving with incised surface detail
patterned/stippled infill conventions (beard curls, brickwork, fleece)
figures shown in a processional/directional arrangement facing one way
animals in profile (rams in B; none comparable in A)
justification: Both show profile human figures in low relief with dense incised patterning used as infill (bearded head and hair curls in B; brickwork, scale armour and archers in A), which suggests broadly comparable relief conventions. But the depicted subjects differ fundamentally: A is a narrative siege scene with archers, a wheeled siege engine and fortified walls, while B is a calm figure leading two horned rams, with no architecture, weapons or action in common.
